info.name: MediaPlatform API
info.description:
End-to-end tests for my-media-platform through the YARP gateway.

Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner or `newman run`). Each run registers two fresh users and creates a post, comments, an image and a dummy video.

Auth: the API reads the JWT from the `jwt` cookie only. Postman's cookie jar is disabled per request; the token is captured from Set-Cookie into the `jwt` collection variable and sent explicitly as `Cookie: jwt={{jwt}}`.

Rate limits: a collection pre-request script waits before /api/auth (5/min) and /api/media + /api/videos (3/min) calls so the run never trips a 429. A full run takes ~4-5 minutes. Set `respectRateLimits` to `false` to disable.

exec: // Client-side throttle that mirrors the gateway rate limiter policies

// Requests whose name starts with "RL " deliberately bypass it.

pm.test('not rate limited by gateway (429)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'hit gateway rate limit - wait a minute and rerun').to.not.eql(429));
